segment.description: Lake Graham — ~500-acre TWRA-owned lake about 9 miles east of Jackson on Cotton Grove Road, Madison County, West Tennessee. TWRA's where-to-fish page lists the fishery as largemouth bass, crappie, bluegill, redear sunfish, and blue & channel catfish; trout appear only in the regulations (7/day, no length limit), reflecting the winter put-and-take program.
segment.boundaries: Entire lake. TWRA's 2026 trout stocking schedule lists 'Lake Graham' as a Winter-type Rainbow Trout site (repo workbook rows: Madison Co., 1/8/2026 and TBD 12/2026). No trout stockings of any other type found for the lake.

holdover.detail: No site-specific holdover evidence found. Program design is winter put-and-take: the only trout rows for Lake Graham in TWRA's 2026 schedule are Winter-type, and the TWRA Trout Management Plan 2017-2027 states hatchery-supported streams and lakes 'are primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round'.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout presence documented. The Trout Management Plan states wild trout are generally limited to East Tennessee's mountain streams; TWRA's Lake Graham page lists no trout among the species found in the lake.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Winter put-and-take only: TWRA's 2026 schedule carries Lake Graham (Madison Co.) solely as a Winter rainbow site, TWRA's own page lists a warmwater species mix, and the Trout Management Plan states hatchery-supported lakes like this cannot support trout year round.

sourcesChecked: repo-local: packages/content/data/twra-stocking-schedule.json (grep: Madison/'Lake Graham' Winter Rainbow Trout rows; zero non-winter rows)
